description: This file defines the SessionManager class responsible for handling user session management, including login, logout, token refresh, and persistence using Keychain, within an iOS app.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A final class managing user authentication sessions, including token storage, refresh, and validation.

methods.name: restoreFromKeychainIfPossible
methods.description: Restores session tokens from Keychain and attempts to authenticate the user if tokens are valid or refresh if expired.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, then persists tokens and updates authentication state.

methods.name: authorizedRequestToken
methods.description: Returns a valid access token, refreshing it if necessary, or throws if not authenticated.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, invalidates the session, and clears stored tokens.

methods.name: refreshIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes the access token if expired or missing, or clears session on failure.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies new tokens to the session state.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears session tokens from Keychain and memory.
